title: 基于钻孔裂隙智能识别的岩体结构面网络重构与稳定性分区研究
visual_status: ORIGINAL 76-PAGE PDF ALL-PAGE VISUAL AUDIT; recovered mega-sheet evidence retained

problem_data_contract.independent_evaluation_unit: Q1 original borehole image/source; Q2 fracture instance; Q3 standard/profile case; Q4 fracture-pair edge registry / connected component / candidate borehole
problem_data_contract.input_structure: 10 project borehole images, 117 external labeled images, periodic fracture masks, Barton standard profiles, six borehole spatial data
problem_data_contract.validation_priority: Q1 split original project images before any augmentation/ConcatDataset; Q2 fixed geometry and residual/reject; Q3 predeclare primary metric when metrics conflict; Q4 build components only from thresholded edge registry and distinguish heuristic score from calibrated probability/EIG
problem_data_contract.author_evaluation_scope: project/external image segmentation comparison, periodic fit results, Barton-profile sampling metrics, heuristic 3D connectivity/uncertainty/drilling results; source notebooks/scripts are referenced but not available

questions.Q1: traditional segmentation vs transfer-learned DeepLabV3+ with 117 external labeled images and manually labeled project images
questions.Q2: DBSCAN fragments + largest-fragment seed + fixed 94.25 mm sinusoid model + model-driven merge/refit
questions.Q3: baseline-normal profile extraction + JRC, compare equal/adaptive/keypoint sampling on Barton standard profiles
questions.Q4: 3D plane geometry + weighted space/orientation/JRC similarity, threshold graph, uncertainty hotspots and three-hole sequential recommendation

not_achieved: R2: paper references notebooks/scripts but actual source files are unavailable in current PDF-only collection
R3-R7: no executable author code/data chain

key_strengths: Q2 enforces P=94.25 mm and uses model-driven fragment merging
Q3 evaluates sampling methods against Barton standard profiles rather than only dense self-reference
Q4 provides explicit edge score decomposition and threshold sensitivity
key_risks: Q1 states all project images are integrated with the external set for training, then evaluates all 10 project images; without an untouched project split the 0.8435/0.9356/0.8779 metrics are not independent test evidence
Q3 keypoint sampling wins R2/RMSE but has 10 ±5% outliers, worse than equal sampling 8 and adaptive 9; "best" depends on predeclared metric utility
Q4 weighted similarity in [0,1] is called connectivity probability without calibration
Q4 says only one edge exceeds >0.5 but later claims a large connected component spanning holes 3,6,2,5; one undirected edge cannot generate a four-hole component
Q4 uncertainty/information-gain language lacks a visible likelihood/posterior update contract
recommended_redo: Q1 freeze original-image/borehole/source holdout before augmentation; compare classical vs compact pretrained segmentation on untouched project images
Q2 use DBSCAN/topology fragments + fixed-frequency linear/robust model merge and explicit reject
Q3 predeclare primary metric or Pareto selection among RMSE/R2/tail outliers; report all without calling a metric-conflicting winner universally best

Q4 generate a machine-readable thresholded edge registry, replay components/paths automatically, label weighted fusion compatibility score unless calibrated, and use true EIG only after observation-model/posterior machinery exists
